about: The record of a local e2e run (tests/e2e/fixtures/observed_calls.ts), limited to the routes of the features tools/conformance/feature_audit.py judges. 'page' means a page's own code sent it; 'test' means only a test's own request did. CI's e2e gate fails if this record claims a write the CI run did not see a page send (icx-cnf-08).
